claims: Fran McCaffery is the head coach of the University of Pennsylvania (Penn) men's basketball team.
Fran McCaffery was hired in April 2025.
In the 2025–26 season, Fran McCaffery led the 14th-seeded Quakers to the NCAA Tournament.
The Quakers won the Ivy League Championship 88–84 in overtime.
Fran McCaffery is one of only a few NCAA Division I coaches to lead five different programs to the NCAA Tournament.
Fran McCaffery led Lehigh, UNC Greensboro, Siena, Iowa, and Penn to the NCAA Tournament.
Fran McCaffery is a 1977 graduate of La Salle College High School.
Fran McCaffery returned to coach at his alma mater.
Fran McCaffery coached at Iowa for 15 seasons.
In the 2025-26 season, Fran McCaffery guided the Quakers to an 18–11 record.
In the 2025-26 season, Fran McCaffery guided the Quakers to an Ivy League title.
Penn State women's basketball program hired Tanisha Wright in March 2026.
